head.title: Aid convoy reaches besieged town in eastern Congo

hedline.hl1: Aid convoy reaches besieged town in eastern Congo

block.p: A convoy of 14 trucks carrying food and medical supplies reached the town of Sake in eastern Congo on Tuesday, the first aid to arrive in three weeks, a humanitarian coordinator said.
Fighting between government forces and rebels had cut the main road west of Goma, leaving an estimated 40,000 displaced people without regular supplies.
